problems_fixed.what: Within-tier duplicate answer. Original silver had TWO problems answering 0.5 (sin 150 and cos 60). Replaced cos 60 (=0.5) with cos 120 (=-0.5), a second-quadrant value that also drills the negative-sign rule; distinct answer.

Reworked filler to keep silver distinct and one rung above bronze. Swapped in tan 180 (=0), which teaches that tan returns to 0 each cycle (asymptotes are at 90/270, not 180); distinct within-tier answer.
problems_fixed.old: How many solutions does sin x = 0 have for 0..360? (solution 3, a bronze-level count)

opener_concept: Big-wheel (Ferris wheel): centre 30 m up, radius 25 m, one turn 40 s. By pure common sense a student gets lowest height 5 m, highest 55 m, and repeat time 40 s, which the reveal names as the midline, amplitude and period of a sine wave, so plotting height against time IS y = sin x.
